components.name: Chart/Survey
components.description: Survey and Likert answers: diverging stacked bars centred on neutral — disagree grows left, agree right, so questions compare at a glance; Net shows agree − disagree per question. 2–12 questions, 3/5/7-point scales on dataviz/diverging. No text on colour (CMP-07) — net score sits outside the bar. React: <SurveyChart questions={[{ label, counts: number[] }]} scale={5} variant="likert |
